beats.speaker: narration
beats.text: Riley lays out all three cards together for the first time.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: The past: the choice you already made.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: The present: what's flourishing right now.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: The future: whatever's opening up next.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Quiz me, then. Does the Lovers being in my past mean that choice is done and I shouldn't think about it again?"

options.text: No — a real choice can still be weighed even after.
Yes, you're not allowed to revisit it.
A past-position card has no relevance anymore.

elaboration: Past position doesn't mean closed book — the Lovers is fine with you weighing it again, even from the other side of the decision.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And the Empress in the present — does that mean I should stop touring and go all in on writing right now?"

options.text: No — it just says something's flourishing, not what to drop.
Yes, you should quit the tour immediately.
The Empress can't apply to two things at once.

elaboration: The Empress names what's alive right now — it isn't handing you an ultimatum about what to give up for it.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "And the Fool in the future — is that a totally different fresh start, unrelated to the writing?"

options.text: Not necessarily — it could be this same thing opening further.
Yes, it has to be something completely separate.
The Fool always cancels out whatever came before.

elaboration: A fresh start doesn't have to mean a different thing entirely — the Fool in the future can just as easily be this same idea taking its next leap.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Last one — do all three cards have to agree with each other to make sense?"

options.text: No — a reading is a conversation between cards, not a consensus.
Yes, if they disagree the reading is wrong.
Only the middle card actually matters.

elaboration: Three cards don't need to point the same direction to be true together — a real choice, a real flourishing, and a real fresh start can all sit side by side.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: One thread ties all three: a choice you stood behind, something real growing because you let it, and room opening up for whatever's next.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Thanks. I think that's the real lesson — the choice I made, what's flourishing right now, and whatever's coming next all belong together. That's exactly what I needed to hear."
